abstention.when_no_active_skill_matches: Do not load an unrelated skill. Use evidence-research only if the task is primarily factual research; otherwise state that no validated skill currently covers the task.
abstention.when_match_is_ambiguous: Ask one focused question if ambiguity changes execution; otherwise state the assumption and proceed conservatively.
abstention.when_evidence_is_insufficient: Return the verified portion and explicitly mark unknowns. Never fill gaps with plausible-sounding claims.
